scope: Historical aggregate of selected root observations across four original runs and three source revisions; not a single full test run or a mandatory gate PASS.

selection_rule.rule: For each exact expected root name, retain every observation in run order and select the final available observation. No observation is deleted or changed. The third run repeats one already passing root; the aggregate counts each expected root once.

unchanged_boundaries.cli717_fixed_v1: Frozen original UNKNOWN command has a separate physical-closure record; no capture from this run was read or included in this aggregate.
unchanged_boundaries.literal_full_v1_full_v8: Outer deadline metadata has terminal_exit_received=false; isolated. Its captures and caches were not read or reused.
unchanged_boundaries.full_v9: Separate continuation metadata reports physical CLOSED with frozen FAIL/UNKNOWN and Source/cache postclosure finalization NOT_RUN. No access or qualification grant is inferred here.

method.review_computation: Data-only byte hashing, JSON parsing, root reconciliation and Git blob hashing; no process execution.
method.metadata_transport: Text transport returned normalized LF; CRLF was reconstructed before hashing original parent/execution metadata. Reconstructed lengths match physical file sizes, and all four execution digests match original parent child_sha256.
